Synthetic reference for PaperMod visual comparisons. No upstream example assets.
Clone https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod into themes/PaperMod, checkout
118119693d8b5ac211b939775678310973bcb232, then run Hugo v0.169.0 with --buildFuture.
Serve public/ on 127.0.0.1:4174. Compare / and /posts/article-1/ at 1280x900 and
390x900 to the Firekylin preview at /papermod/index and /papermod/post.
